Finally, we return the maximum capacity found.

<solution>
```python
def tram(n, ai, bi):
    max_capacity = 0
    current_capacity = 0
    for i in range(n):
        current_capacity += bi[i] - ai[i]
        max_capacity = max(max_capacity, current_capacity)
    return max_capacity
```
